name: dev.forestrie/resolve
description: Fetches from a Forestrie log or its chain the material @forestrie/mcp-verify verifies (receipts, genesis documents, accumulator snapshots, registration status, service configuration) and says where every byte came from and which of the four questions of the trust model it can support. The courier, not the verifier; no writes, no polling, no default operator or chain provider.

environmentVariables.name: FORESTRIE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: SCRAPI base URL used when a call omits baseUrl. Optional; the package ships no default and names no operator.

environmentVariables.name: FORESTRIE_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: JSON-RPC endpoint used when a call omits rpcUrl: your own chain access. Optional; the package ships no default and names no provider.
